overall: MARGINAL overall: west easing and fishable this evening, Coron side calm, current pickup in the south tonight
limiterDetail: The main limiter now is current: Tara and Turda build to 1.0–1.3 kt about 6 PM–midnight, and Decabaitot, Barangonan and Alava reach 1.0–1.1 kt about 3–5 AM Sat. Wind is second: Barangonan 13.5 kt now easing to 8–10 kt by 7 PM; Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Nangalao 11–12 kt now, 8–10 kt this evening; then the west rebuilds to 13–15 kt Saturday about 5 AM–noon. Coron, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan, Tara, Decabobo and Turda stay under 9 kt until Saturday morning. Rain is light: 24h totals 0.3–7.1 mm (Barangonan 7.1, Linapacan 4.4), with brief showers in the west about 3–5 AM Sat.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. The feed is reachable again and has no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA (latest entries are Visayas gale advisories from 26 Oct). See the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: Sunday 1 supply trimmed to SLIGHTLY SOFT (was normal with a slight trim). Saturday now looks wetter, 8.0 mm regionally (was 3.1), and the west wind comes back Saturday morning: Nangalao, Ciron, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 13–15 kt from about 5 AM to noon. Sunday is wetter too (14.1 mm, was 10.8), so the Monday 2 dip deepens , and Tuesday is breezier (9.7 kt, was 6.3), so the Wednesday 4 recovery is now only partial.

The good news is today: the west eased on schedule (10–13.5 kt now, 7.5–9 kt this evening) and tonight's showers mostly fizzled (Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 2.4 mm in 24h, was 9.3), so the west fishes this afternoon and evening. Today stays SLIGHTLY SOFT and Saturday 31 stays NEAR NORMAL. The grounds read 5 GOOD / 11 MARGINAL / 0 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (was 8 GOOD this morning; Culion, Tara, Decabobo and Turda slipped to marginal on the afternoon current pickup). PAGASA is reachable again and shows no warning for Palawan.

bestWindow.headline: Now to about 10 AM Sat on the Coron side, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan; the west about 5 PM to 3 AM tonight
details: Coron side and Panlaitan, now to Sat 10 AM: currents 0.0–0.6 kt with wind 1–9 kt and mostly dry. The easiest spell is about 11 PM–3 AM (0.1–0.3 kt, wind under 6 kt at Coron, Galoc and Culion).
West, about 5 PM–3 AM: Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 8–10 kt with 0.1–0.4 kt current, Ciron 7–9 kt (0.4–0.5 kt), Linapacan 5–8 kt (0.3 kt), Barangonan 8–10 kt after its 6–8 PM shower.

Keep small boats off Tara and Turda about 6 PM–midnight (1.0–1.3 kt), off Decabaitot, Barangonan and Alava about 3–5 AM Sat (1.0–1.1 kt), and off Nangalao, Ciron, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot Saturday about 5 AM–noon (13–15 kt).
